history: Yinchuan, ancient Xingqing Prefecture, was the Western Xia capital for 189 years. The rammed-earth royal tombs under Helan Mountain are called 'pyramids of the East'; rock carvings record the nomads' lives. 'The Yellow River enriches Ningxia' — two thousand years of irrigation made the plain the 'Jiangnan beyond the frontier'.
importance: Capital of Ningxia · Jiangnan beyond the Great Wall
foods: Tan lamb — tender, with no gamey smell.
The skewer hotpot Yinchuan kids grew up on.
Red chili oil with lung noodles — a strong morning taste.
Glass noodles and mushrooms stewed with tan lamb.
Zhongning goji berries — the nation's best.
Eight-treasure covered-bowl tea, sweet with a long finish.
Clear-broth tan lamb hotpot — incomparably fresh.
scenes: Nine imperial tombs — 'the pyramids of the East'.
A 40,000-year prehistoric site and Ming wall.
A Yellow River ferry crossing with desert wetlands.
'West Lake of the frontier' — a birding paradise.
Suyukou's pine forests and blue sheep.
